name: shopify-cro-audit
description: Conversion-rate-optimization audit for a Shopify store, following an 11-step CRO audit framework (analytics, LIFT heuristics, review mining, customer support, heatmaps, surveys, user testing, marketing-match, competitor analysis). Pulls live data through the Shopify MCP (ShopifyQL) and/or GA4 + Shopify CSV exports — the two paths combine — with the entire Step-1 analytics block machine-computed, never hand-transcribed. Emits a 3-format deliverable bundle: an interactive self-contained HTML report (primary deliverable, live 0-150 Funnel Health gauge, (Impact×2)+Ease re-ranking), an Obsidian-ready markdown record, and a formula-driven xlsx backup — plus Concentration (HHI/Gini/Pareto-ABC) and CVR Signals (Wilson CIs, z-tests, empirical-Bayes page CVRs) analytics computed straight from the raw data files. Missing-data steps are declared 'Not run', never fabricated. openpyxl (>=3.1) needed only for the xlsx.
